Removed @ts-nocheck from CanvasToy.astro inline script. Added proper types for all DOM refs, simCleanup, toy arrays. astro check: 0 errors.

Extracted pause toggle DOM creation from game-of-life start() into renderHeaderControls(container). CanvasToy now provides #canvas-toy-header-controls container. Toy no longer hunts for close button by ID.

Added prev/next navigation row between canvas and footer in CanvasToy.astro. Buttons cycle through toy index with wrap-around. Position indicator shows '1/2'. Row hidden when only 1 toy registered. switchToToy() handles cleanup of previous simulation and header controls before starting next.
Renamed steer() parameters from targetX/targetY to desiredVX/desiredVY. Added JSDoc clarifying the function computes steering toward a desired velocity (not position).
Replaced scrollToTarget(0) call in Contact.astro with native window.scrollTo({top:0, behavior:'smooth'}). No dependency on main.js load order.

Removed window.initCardTilt global. Tilt is already initialized on all .card-glow elements at page load (including hidden project cards). The re-init call in the projects expand handler was redundant — cards are only shown/hidden via display toggle, never removed from DOM.
Replaced expandBtn.innerHTML with textContent manipulation + icon style.transform toggle. No hardcoded lord-icon CDN URLs. The existing DOM icon is kept and only rotated via CSS.

Added clear 'keep in sync' comments in both the frontmatter imports and script imports. This is an architectural constraint of Astro's island model — frontmatter runs at build time for SSR, script runs on client. Functions can't be serialized via define:vars. The Vite bundler deduplicates the actual module code in the output.

Already implemented during P2 CanvasToy refactor: toy.start() is wrapped in try/catch with console error logging and a canvas fallback message. User can still close the panel or switch to another toy.
Capped border penetration at margin width using Math.min(). Strong attraction near edges can no longer produce unbounded velocity growth.

Added dark-mode-aware cache in both toys. readColors() only calls getComputedStyle on theme change (detected via document.documentElement.classList), returns cached values otherwise. One recompute per theme toggle instead of every frame.
Extracted getIconColors() call to top of setTheme(); passed result to updateIconColors(colors) and reused for expand button. Single getComputedStyle per theme toggle.
Wrapped entire Projects JS section in block comment. Clear markers show where to uncomment when Projects component is re-enabled in index.astro.

Extracted ThemeToggleIcon.astro component accepting size and strokeWidth props. Navbar now uses <ThemeToggleIcon size={20} strokeWidth={1.5} /> for desktop and <ThemeToggleIcon size={24} strokeWidth={2} /> for mobile instead of ~60 lines of duplicated SVG.
